<thought>To locate the template for the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) reaction, I will search the retrosynthetic template catalog using a representative product (acrylic acid, SMILES C=CC(=O)O). I will specify the bond changes characteristic of the forward HWE reaction: formation of a C‑C bond, cleavage of a C‑P bond and a C‑O bond, and an increase in bond order from a single to a double bond (C=C). These criteria should retrieve the appropriate template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)O",
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (1.0->2.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
